2026 gift of $50,000 each to 3 recipients: taxable gifts $93,000. Form 709 is required. Lifetime exemption left: $14,907,000 of $15,000,000. Gift tax due now: $0. The 2026 annual exclusion is $19,000 per recipient (IRS).

Federal estate and gift tax only. State estate and inheritance taxes are not included. General information, not legal or tax advice; Forms 706 and 709 and their instructions decide the official amounts.
